mean_cn: v.孵出，孵；  v.使孵出；策划，（尤指）密谋；  n.舱口；舱门
mean_en: (of a young bird, fish, insect, etc.) to come out of an egg; (of an egg) to break open so that a young bird, fish, insect, etc. can come out; to make a young bird, fish, insect, etc. come out of an egg
sentence: The baby chicks finally hatch out.
